## Brand Checklist

- [ ] Uses tokens from `@sports/brand`; no hardcoded hex outside approved brand files.
- [ ] Uses approved typography only: Exo 2, Inter, or the configured mono stack.
- [ ] Does not use forbidden AI positioning for Galaxy's product category.
- [ ] Keeps betting-risk language clear and visible.
- [ ] If copy mentions losses, losses remain visible and unhidden.
- [ ] If copy mentions confidence, it does not imply certainty.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint:brand`
- [ ] Relevant package tests
